annotations.title: Read what was sent to one person

description: Reads up to 50 of the emails the app has sent one person (by their id, from dev_people/live_people) — kind, subject, when, and whether it was answered (a support reply only). Never the email's own body. A subject is the founder's own template unless it is a reply, where it may carry the customer's own words back ("Re: …") — wrapped, like any customer text. This is what a founder may call checking whether someone got an email.
name: sends_read
